checks: Truncation, appended data and another project identity reject before any emulated state write.
Header/schema and bank digest failures reject.
Malformed version, fields and signed offsets reject even when both checksums have been recomputed.
An empty project bank is a valid disabled/default state.
limits: This is a separate PC sidecar, not native Digitone project persistence. No native save/load or pattern-change callback invokes it.
Project identity is supplied by the PC caller; matching an actual project and maintaining it after native edits are not integrated.
